plan.question: Why does the exact original magnitude-only candidate fail to repeat its validation advantage under identical exported source/config and the declared seed-42 recipe, while the unchanged-gradient control repeats its aggregate metrics? r0017-half_total_magnitude and r0019-exact17_replay share source SHA256 6e9e41cc4cf0e92b1036f82de88e6c214343288d1fa7de2865237d3d580106d2, but AUC changes from 0.6152795936767026 to 0.6149279138846995, reversing M-N from +0.0001774051692154 to -0.0001742746227877; N remains at 0.6151021885074872. Both executions succeeded. The M18 exact-source replay also drifts. Candidate-authored common-state M17/M18 probes at calls 0 and 512 report near-repeat-floor complete-gradient differences and zero cross-source Adam parameter-update differences, covering only 2 of 14661 calls. Retrieve execution-lineage evidence that can distinguish initialization/data-order/environment/checkpoint differences from intervention-sensitive numerical accumulation or later guard/backward differences, and identify the earliest divergent state if an authorized trace interface becomes available. Existing early probes cannot establish whole-run equivalence or identify a root cause. Preserve the negative uniform-energy and rotated-allocation branches and the historical winning receipt; do not treat another architecture/scale sweep or a repeat of only the two early probes as resolving this limitation. Independent-seed benefit and optimizer mediation remain separate unanswered questions.
missing_information: Authorized execution manifests for original and replay runs: initialization and RNG-state identities, batch/sample-order identities, existing determinism settings, software/device versions, optimizer setup, checkpoint-selection events, and selected checkpoint/prediction hashes. Source/config hashes and seed metadata alone do not establish execution identity; private runtime internals are outside the research boundary.

An explicitly authorized bounded trace or host-owned checker exposing actual parameter/gradient/Adam-moment/update identities at predeclared states, enough to bracket the first same-source divergence across complete runs. No such interface, source files, checkpoints or training capability is exported in the current query phase; existing candidate-authored probes are not independent verification.

Later-state and rare-guard coverage, plus a prospectively specified comparison rule based on same-source repeat measurements; no post hoc tolerance should convert the existing failed performance replay into success. Trace instrumentation itself requires a matched perturbation control if later admitted.

Complete paired new-seed M/N outcomes at seeds 43 and 44 after lineage checks, with frozen exact sources/configs, loss and measured costs. Seed-42 replays are reproducibility checks, not independent mechanism repetitions, and current evidence does not establish repeatable benefit.

A refreshed full-cost ledger and actual trace/checkpoint/repetition/closed-assessment tariffs before admitting later work. Reserve complete paired controls and assessment; no training, protocol changes, installations or withheld assessment is authorized by this retrieval plan.

Primary literature specifically addressing gradient-intervention reproducibility and Adam/numerical accumulation. Authorized paper search for gradient surgery reproducibility nondeterminism returned no matches; this is a coverage gap, not evidence of novelty or a demonstrated numerical cause.
